modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Uncapped rendering, low-latency mouse input, and high-refresh visuals.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Removes active-window VSync and internal FPS limits, reduces mouse latency, and eliminates safe loading delays while leaving hotbar input Vanilla-owned.
herzium.config.title: Herzium
herzium.config.subtitle: High-refresh performance, clearly controlled
herzium.config.how.vanilla: Hotbar keys 1-9 are consumed only by Vanilla's normal input loop. Herzium does not observe, reorder, consume, preview, or write the selected slot and sends no hotbar packets, so another mod that owns hotbar positions remains authoritative.
herzium.config.how.hands: Ordinary items use a 0 ms equip transition. Swords, axes, pickaxes, spears, maces, bows, crossbows, tridents, shields, and other tagged weapons retain Vanilla's visible equip transition. Swinging, use, cooldowns, ticks, reach, and server validation remain Vanilla.
herzium.config.how.inventory: Inventories and containers remain on the active rendering cadence, while their world background stays fully controlled by Vanilla or another installed visual mod.
herzium.config.risk.performance: Uncapped rendering can increase CPU/GPU use, heat, power consumption, fan noise, FPS drops, or uneven frame times.
herzium.config.risk.mixins: Another mod that redirects the same input, HUD, hand-rendering, VSync, or frame-limit methods may conflict with Herzium or replace part of its behavior.
herzium.config.risk.attestation: Servers, launchers, or modpacks that require client-mod attestation or an approved mod list may identify that Herzium is installed.
herzium.config.risk.server: Herzium does not speed up game ticks, bypass server authority, alter interaction timing, or add hotbar packets. Visual speed does not change server rules.
herzium.config.issue.config_read: The configuration file could not be read. Herzium is using in-memory defaults.
herzium.config.issue.config_write: The configuration file could not be written. The visible option may not survive a restart.
herzium.config.issue.mixin_missing: Required mixin not reported as applied: %s
herzium.config.issue.exordium: Exordium is loaded, but its optional Herzium bypass was not reported as applied.
herzium.config.issue.external_input_coll: Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris are both loaded and own overlapping low-level mouse pipelines. Herzium disables only Vanilla Raw Input; remove one external input mod.
Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris own overlapping low-level mouse pipelines. Herzium leaves Vanilla Raw Input unchanged because another mod owns the input-window decision; remove one external input mod.
herzium.config.issue.raw_input_cursor_ad: Raw Input Buffer is loaded, but KoHs Inventory Tweaks is missing. Cursor Landing and its verified late-recentering suppression are unavailable.
herzium.config.issue.raw_input_buffer: Raw Input Buffer owns mouse deltas. Herzium disables Vanilla Raw Input; KoHs Inventory Tweaks supplies the narrow Cursor Landing recentering adapter.
herzium.config.issue.raw_input_buffer_cu: Raw Input Buffer owns mouse deltas and KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium leaves the player's Vanilla Raw Input window mode unchanged.
herzium.config.issue.ixeris: Ixeris owns an external input thread. Herzium disables Vanilla Raw Input but cannot safely disable Ixeris internals; avoid combining it with another raw-input mod.
herzium.config.issue.ixeris_cursor_owner: Ixeris owns its external input thread and KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium leaves the player's Vanilla Raw Input window mode unchanged.
herzium.config.issue.pending_note: A mixin waiting for its first input or render path is pending, not an error.
herzium.warning.title: HERZIUM WARNING
herzium.warning.message: Herzium removes active-window frame-rate limits and prioritizes minimum input latency. Depending on your hardware, drivers, settings, and other mods, it may cause instability, FPS drops, uneven frame times, high GPU or CPU usage, extra heat, or increased power consumption. Use it at your own risk.
herzium.warning.quote: Speed is essential, but control turns it into performance.
herzium.option.instant_equip.description: Ordinary items appear in hand with no equip dip. Weapons and shields keep Vanilla's transition. Turning this off restores Vanilla's equip transition for every item.
herzium.option.hotbar_preview.descriptio: Shows the slot you just pressed in the HUD and in hand before Vanilla's next tick commits it. Herzium never writes the real selection, and the preview suspends itself if it ever disagrees with Vanilla.
